primary_result: No validation-scene measurement estimate is available: all 1,000 definition scenes and all 1,000 validation scenes were excluded because the entrypoint incorrectly required haze and transmission filename stems to be identical.
gate_reasons: The qualified RESIDE identity and all frozen dataset counts matched.
The entrypoint's direct filename-stem mapping was false for the organized ITS files.
Zero independent scenes completed measurement, so every precision, coverage, q-recovery, and negative-control gate is uninformative.
Only a mapping-only measurement supplement is authorized; model selection and indoor baseline behavior measurement remain unauthorized.
competing_explanation: The prior read-only qualification found physically reconstructable ITS haze/transmission pairing, so the zero-scene result is consistent with a reader mapping error rather than absence of usable paired data; that explanation must be tested by a frozen physical-reconstruction mapping supplement.
limitations: This terminal provides no evidence for or against the q measurement, the transmission construct, restoration-demand heterogeneity, or ConvIR-B behavior.
The 2,000 selected clear scenes establish intended sample capacity only; they do not count as measured independent observations.
No model training, inference, SOTS, OTS, Haze4K test, NH-HAZE, outdoor, canary, confirmation, or locked-test access occurred.
Outdoor and real-haze calibration remain mandatory independent stages even if the mapping supplement later passes.
